formal_name: Phase 5.6B VM-01A Fault Fixture Frozen Authority Maintenance R3
scope: VM-01A deterministic controller-side fault primitive only

proof_intent: StagePath is fully populated and verified before fault application
Fault is applied only at the existing post-Verify/pre-rename barrier
Terminal result truthfully reports cleanup failure
Residue remains contained beneath the canonical root
ARP and Start Menu surfaces are not published
Unrelated state is not mutated and false success is forbidden

authoritative_sources.title: CreateFile function
facts: FILE_SHARE_DELETE permits subsequent opens requesting delete access; omission prevents them
Delete access includes delete and rename operations
Sharing options remain effective until the handle is closed
FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS is required to obtain a directory handle
OPEN_EXISTING is the valid directory disposition

authoritative_sources.title: MoveFileEx function
facts: MoveFileEx moves an existing file or directory
Delete or rename may be authorized by object DELETE or parent DELETE_CHILD

authoritative_sources.title: DeleteFile function
facts: Delete or rename requires either delete permission on the object or delete-child permission in the parent

authoritative_sources.title: File Access Rights Constants
facts: DELETE is a distinct standard object right

r2_failure_explanation.parent_delete_child: remained allowed through the canonical parent
r2_failure_explanation.reason: Windows may authorize rename or deletion through either path, so denying object DELETE alone does not negate parent DELETE_CHILD

candidate_a_parent_delete_child_acl.mechanism: At the barrier, deny FILE_DELETE_CHILD on the canonical parent and also neutralize the independently sufficient object DELETE path on StagePath
risks: Parent mutation affects AppPath, old directories, siblings, and other child operations
Inherited and direct ACE evaluation requires two-path effective-right proof
Restoration must survive installer failure and controller interruption
Parent denial can interfere with unrelated cleanup or surface behavior
candidate_a_parent_delete_child_acl.falsification: Rejected because a precise parent-only denial is bypassed by object DELETE, while controlling both paths broadens mutation beyond exact StagePath and increases restoration/security risk

candidate_b_non_delete_sharing_handle.mechanism: Open and retain one handle to exact verified StagePath without FILE_SHARE_DELETE
candidate_b_non_delete_sharing_handle.acquisition_boundary: After verified-stage-ready, StagePath publication, containment/topology verification, and before signalling Continue
candidate_b_non_delete_sharing_handle.lifetime: Retain continuously while unchanged activation rename and subsequent cleanup execute; close only after installer completion and result/evidence capture, or during bounded controller failure cleanup
candidate_b_non_delete_sharing_handle.privilege: No elevation or backup privilege required; FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS enables a directory handle but does not itself bypass ordinary security checks
candidate_b_non_delete_sharing_handle.activation_effect: A rename requires delete access; the retained handle omitted FILE_SHARE_DELETE, so the rename open fails with sharing violation
candidate_b_non_delete_sharing_handle.cleanup_effect: Children remain independently accessible and may be deleted; final removal of exact StagePath requires delete access and fails while the handle remains open
candidate_b_non_delete_sharing_handle.scope: Exact disposable guest-local StagePath object only
candidate_b_non_delete_sharing_handle.race_control: The existing barrier holds the installer before rename; handle acquisition and causal probe complete before exactly one Continue signal
causal_evidence: Handle value is valid and not INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE
Final path or file identity from the handle equals verified StagePath
Share mask is exactly READ|WRITE with DELETE absent
A non-mutating probe open requesting DELETE fails with ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION while the handle is retained
Handle remains open through installer completion and result capture
candidate_b_non_delete_sharing_handle.stale_handle_behavior: No named or persistent object; handle is process-local and released by CloseHandle or process termination; R2 revert remains final isolation

comparative_falsification.parent_acl: Only if both parent DELETE_CHILD and object DELETE authorization paths are controlled
comparative_falsification.handle: PASS: omitted FILE_SHARE_DELETE blocks later delete-access open used for rename

comparative_falsification.parent_acl: Requires two-scope ACL design and proof
comparative_falsification.handle: PASS: children can be removed but final StagePath removal is blocked

comparative_falsification.parent_acl: Risk if applied early; existing barrier mitigates but does not narrow parent scope
comparative_falsification.handle: None; exact handle is acquired only at barrier

comparative_falsification.parent_acl: DACL capture and reliable restoration required
comparative_falsification.handle: CloseHandle; process termination is fail-safe release

comparative_falsification.parent_acl: Complex effective-right proof across two objects
comparative_falsification.handle: Direct handle identity, share mask, sharing-violation probe, lifetime chronology
PASS without candidate or barrier change

controller_steps: Receive exact StagePath from the existing authenticated local-session barrier contract
Verify canonical containment, direct-parent topology, stage existence, completed verification, and no preservation/activation rename
Call CreateFileW with the frozen parameters and fail closed if acquisition fails
Verify handle identity maps to exact StagePath
Perform one non-mutating DELETE-access probe and require ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION
Retain handle through unchanged RenameFile and DelTree paths and installer result completion
Close handle exactly once during deterministic controller cleanup
forbidden: Any parent or sibling ACL mutation
Generic lock or arbitrary path input
Candidate, Build036, barrier, preparation, VM, or checkpoint mutation

barrier_and_release_preservation.placement: After VerifyStagedPayload(StagePath), before any preservation or activation rename

qualified_transport_preservation.host_process: bounded fresh native PowerShell process per operation
qualified_transport_preservation.powershell_direct: one fresh New-PSSession/Remove-PSSession pair per operation; never reused

basis: Existing barrier exposes exact verified StagePath at the required boundary
Existing local-session synchronization and 120000 ms timeout remain sufficient
Candidate, projected source, preparation authority, and Build036 bytes remain unchanged

alternatives.mechanism: Parent DELETE_CHILD plus object DELETE control

windows_semantics.basis: Microsoft CreateFile sharing semantics directly establish that omitting FILE_SHARE_DELETE blocks later delete-access opens, and delete access includes rename. Exact-directory handle requirements are explicit.

authority_fidelity.basis: INS-025/056/069, the single barrier, expected result, compile-time isolation, release absence, and VM accounting remain unchanged; only the falsified controller fault primitive is replaced.

security_testability.basis: The selected mechanism is exact-path, process-local, bounded, race-free at the existing barrier, nonpersistent, Medium-token compatible, and provides direct causal evidence without parent or host mutation.
